# Immaculate Spaces

Immaculate Spaces is a women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly house cleaning service based in Dallas, TX, available 24 hours a day. Known for exceptional thoroughness, strong communication, and a customer-first approach, the business is led by Shelly and has earned a perfect 5-star reputation. The brand stands out for its ability to accommodate last-minute bookings, its attention to detail, and its warm, reassuring client experience — making it a trusted choice for both routine and deep cleaning needs.

Source: https://immaculate-spaces.zappy5.app

# House cleaning services for real Dallas life.


Choose the level of care your home needs today — from regular upkeep to deep cleaning after a stressful week, before guests, or after another cleaner missed the mark.

Request Service

















## What we can help with.














### Routine House Cleaning


Recurring care for kitchens, baths, bedrooms, floors, dusting, and high-touch areas — keeping your home consistently fresh and welcoming.


Recommended for weekly and bi-weekly upkeep.









### Deep Cleaning


Detailed reset for buildup, corners, surfaces, appliances, and neglected spots — perfect for a seasonal refresh or special occasion.


Recommended for first-time bookings and seasonal resets.









### Carpet Cleaning


Freshening carpets and soft surfaces, removing embedded dirt and allergens — available by appointment for a truly complete clean.


Recommended for homes with pets, kids, or seasonal allergy concerns.









### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning


Make the space feel ready before or after a transition — thorough top-to-bottom cleaning for a fresh start.


Recommended for renters, sellers, and anyone relocating.









### Last-Minute Cleaning


Flexible help when plans change quickly — our team accommodates urgent requests with the same thorough care.


Recommended for unexpected guests, events, or last-minute needs.









### New Parent Support Cleans


Gentle, detail-focused cleaning for nurseries, bedrooms, laundry areas, and common spaces — creating a calm, safe environment for your growing family.


Recommended for expecting parents and families with newborns.















## Clear communication from first message to final walkthrough.




1


### Tell us what happened


Share your space, timing, and priorities — we listen carefully to understand exactly what your home needs.




2


### We confirm the plan


Shelly reviews details, recommendations, and availability — then sends a clear, reassuring confirmation before we arrive.




3


### We clean with care


The team works thoroughly, respecting your home and keeping you reassured with updates when needed.

# Led by Shelly. Built on care, clarity, and respect.


Immaculate Spaces serves Dallas homes with a customer-first approach that prioritizes communication, trust, and exceptional thoroughness. As a women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly professional residential cleaning service, we believe that inviting someone into your home should feel safe, reassuring, and completely stress-free.


Whether you need a last-minute refresh or a meticulous deep clean, our team treats every space with the warmth and attention to detail it deserves — because a spotless home is just the beginning of the relief we deliver.









"We want every client to feel informed, respected, and relieved when the job is done."















## A cleaning service designed to feel safe to welcome in.








### Women-owned


A business led with accountability and care. Shelly's leadership ensures every clean is performed with the same attention to detail she'd give her own home.








### LGBTQ+ friendly


Respectful service for every household. We believe everyone deserves to feel comfortable and safe inviting professional domestic cleaning services into their home.








### Detail-focused


Thorough cleaning with attention to overlooked spaces. From baseboards to ceiling fans, our professional carpet cleaning services and deep cleans leave no corner untouched.








### Responsive


Available 24 hours for urgent or unusual timing. We know life doesn't follow a schedule, which is why we're always ready to accommodate last-minute bookings and special requests.












## Every home deserves respect.


Whether you are a busy professional, a new parent, a pet owner, part of the LGBTQ+ community, or simply someone who needs help without judgment, Immaculate Spaces approaches each visit with warmth and discretion.


No judgment
Clear communication
Careful attention















Warm, thoughtful cleaning that feels like coming home. Women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly, and always here when you need us.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  8/2/2026



Immaculate Spaces ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Immaculate Spaces

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: 2148923324

- Address: Dallas, TX, US



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  August 2, 2026



Immaculate Spaces is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Immaculate Spaces

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: 2148923324



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  August 2, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - Immaculate Spaces

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - Home Services / Cleaning provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


Immaculate Spaces provides Home Services / Cleaning through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

If services include payment:


- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

- Refunds will be processed within 14 business days of cancellation approval




## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by Immaculate Spaces. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.


## 12. General Provisions

- Non-enforcement of a right will not be considered a waiver
